practice.title: Adam and AdamW step
practice.summary: One Adam update with bias correction and a step counter that starts at 1, plus AdamW decoupled weight decay, as a pure function of the state.

practice.title: Batch normalization forward and backward
practice.summary: Training and inference forward passes with running statistics, and the full backward pass for x, gamma and beta.

practice.title: Beam search with EOS and length normalization
practice.summary: Keep the best beam_width partial sequences over a step function, finish beams at EOS, and rank them with a length penalty.

practice.title: BM25 ranking
practice.summary: Score tokenized documents against a query with BM25: the lesson idf, term frequency saturation with k1, length normalization with b, and a ranked list.

practice.title: BPE pair counts and merges
practice.summary: Count weighted adjacent pairs, pick the best pair with a fixed tie rule, merge it without overlap and train a BPE merge list.

practice.title: CLIP symmetric contrastive loss
practice.summary: Normalize image and text embeddings, build the temperature-scaled similarity matrix, and compute the symmetric InfoNCE loss and its gradient.

practice.title: Cosine similarity top-k search
practice.summary: Normalize embedding rows, score queries against documents with cosine similarity, and return the top k documents with a fixed tie rule.

practice.title: DDPM noise schedule, closed form noising and posterior
practice.summary: Build the linear beta schedule and alpha bars, sample x_t from x_0 in closed form, and compute the mean and variance of q(x_{t-1} | x_t, x_0).

practice.title: Discounted returns with episode ends
practice.summary: Reward-to-go returns for one episode and for a batch of joined episodes with done flags, plus return normalization.

practice.title: DPO loss and implicit rewards
practice.summary: The direct preference optimization loss, its implicit rewards and its gradient, from policy and reference log probabilities.

practice.title: Tiled attention with an online softmax
practice.summary: FlashAttention in numpy: a running max and a running sum over key blocks give exact attention for any block size.

practice.title: Focal loss
practice.summary: Binary and multi-class focal loss with gamma and alpha, from logits and without overflow, plus the binary gradient.

practice.title: Generalized advantage estimation
practice.summary: TD errors and GAE advantages with gamma, lambda, done flags and a bootstrap value, plus the critic targets.

practice.title: Gini impurity and the best split
practice.summary: Gini impurity and the best decision tree split over all features, with midpoint thresholds, weighted child impurity and a fixed tie rule.

practice.title: Linear regression by gradient descent
practice.summary: Mean squared error, its gradients for weights and bias, and a batch gradient descent loop that records the cost after each update.

practice.title: Grouped-query attention
practice.summary: GQA forward with H query heads and G shared key and value groups, plus mean pooling of a multi-head checkpoint into groups.

practice.title: GRPO group advantages and clipped objective
practice.summary: Normalize rewards within each group, estimate the KL with k3, and compute the clipped GRPO objective averaged per answer over valid tokens.

practice.title: Symmetric int8 quantization
practice.summary: Absmax int8 quantization with one scale per tensor and one scale per row, with dequantization and a zero-row rule.

practice.title: Inverted dropout
practice.summary: Inverted dropout with a given random generator: training forward with an exact mask, backward with the same mask, identity at inference.

practice.title: K-means assignment and update
practice.summary: The k-means assignment and update steps with a tie rule and an empty cluster rule, and a full run until the assignments stop changing.

practice.title: Fixed-capacity KV cache
practice.summary: Append keys and values to a preallocated cache, attend one query over the valid prefix, and reject an append past the capacity.

practice.title: Measure bias and variance
practice.summary: Fit polynomials of degree 1 to 12 on resampled training sets and measure bias squared, variance and test error at each degree.

practice.title: Sweep the learning rate
practice.summary: Sweep gradient descent learning rates on a seeded regression, find the best rate and the first rate that diverges, and compare with 2 over the top eigenvalue.

practice.title: Sweep the quantization bit width
practice.summary: Sweep symmetric absmax quantization from 2 to 8 bits on weights with outliers, compare one scale per tensor with one scale per row.

practice.title: Sweep the sampling temperature
practice.summary: Sweep the temperature on fixed logits, measure entropy and top 1 probability, find where entropy crosses 2 bits, and count the tokens top p keeps.

practice.title: Read an SGLang sweep on an L4
practice.summary: Use real SGLang runs on an NVIDIA L4 to find the saturation point, the SLO limit, the FP8 gain and the effect of a smaller prefill chunk.

practice.title: LayerNorm and RMSNorm
practice.summary: LayerNorm with gamma and beta and RMSNorm with a weight, both over the last axis, with eps inside the square root.

practice.title: Logistic regression from scratch
practice.summary: A stable sigmoid, the binary cross-entropy loss and its gradient, and a gradient descent loop that records the loss.

practice.title: LoRA linear layer
practice.summary: Forward pass of a linear layer with a low rank adapter, merge of the adapter into the weight, and the trainable parameter count.

practice.title: Top-k MoE gating and the Switch load-balancing loss
practice.summary: Route tokens to the top k experts with renormalized softmax gates, and compute the Switch Transformer auxiliary loss E times sum f_i P_i.

practice.title: Backpropagation through a two-layer MLP
practice.summary: Forward pass with a cache and a backward pass that returns the gradient of every weight and bias of a two-layer sigmoid network.

practice.title: Split heads, merge heads, multi-head attention
practice.summary: Reshape (B, T, D) into H heads and back, then run batched multi-head self-attention with given projection matrices.

practice.title: Vectorized pairwise distances
practice.summary: Euclidean distance and cosine similarity matrices from one matrix product, with a clip at 0 and a zero-vector rule.

practice.title: Power iteration for the top eigenpair
practice.summary: The top eigenvalue and eigenvector of a symmetric matrix by power iteration, with a tolerance, an iteration limit and a sign rule.

practice.title: PPO clipped surrogate loss
practice.summary: The PPO loss to minimize from new and old log probabilities and advantages, the clip fraction, and the gradient with respect to the new log probabilities.

practice.title: Q-learning and SARSA updates
practice.summary: One tabular Q-learning or SARSA update with no bootstrap at a terminal step, and epsilon-greedy actions from a seeded rng with lowest-index ties.

practice.title: Reciprocal rank fusion
practice.summary: Merge several ranked lists of document ids into one ranking with reciprocal rank fusion, optional list weights and a fixed tie rule.

practice.title: Rectified flow loss and Euler sampler
practice.summary: Interpolate along straight paths, regress the velocity x1 - x0 with the flow matching loss, and integrate a velocity field with Euler steps.

practice.title: Rotary position embedding
practice.summary: Rotate adjacent coordinate pairs of queries and keys by position times base^(-2i/d), so attention scores depend only on the position gap.

practice.title: Scaled dot-product attention with a mask
practice.summary: Batched softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k)) V with an optional boolean mask, plus the causal mask that a decoder uses.

practice.title: SGD with momentum
practice.summary: One momentum update with the lesson's velocity rule, and a loop that minimizes a quadratic with or without Nesterov lookahead.

practice.title: Sinusoidal positional encoding
practice.summary: Build the sin and cos position table with interleaved columns and base 10000, and add it to a batch of token embeddings.

practice.title: Stable softmax and cross-entropy
practice.summary: Batched softmax, mean cross-entropy and its gradient, without overflow for large logits.

practice.title: Speculative decoding: accept, reject and resample
practice.summary: The min(1, p/q) acceptance rule and the residual distribution that keep speculative decoding exactly equal to the target model.

practice.title: Parse and validate tool calls
practice.summary: Parse tool calls from a raw model reply and validate their arguments against a JSON Schema subset with JSON pointer error paths.

practice.title: Temperature, top-k and top-p sampling
practice.summary: Scale logits by temperature, keep the top k or the top p mass, renormalize, and draw one token with a seeded rng.

practice.title: Train a character bigram language model
practice.summary: Train a table of next-character logits with gradient descent until the held-out negative log-likelihood beats a unigram model.

practice.title: Fit a sine curve with a tanh network
practice.summary: Train a 1-16-1 tanh network on noisy samples of sin(x) until its held-out mean squared error against the true curve is below 0.01.

practice.title: Train softmax regression on four blobs
practice.summary: Train multinomial logistic regression with gradient descent to reach a held-out accuracy and log loss target on four Gaussian blobs.

practice.title: Train a tanh network on two spirals
practice.summary: Train a 2-24-24-1 tanh network with mini-batch Adam until it separates two noisy spirals with 95 percent held-out accuracy.

practice.title: Train a 2-4-1 network on XOR
practice.summary: Train a small sigmoid network with full-batch gradient descent until it labels noisy XOR points with 95 percent held-out accuracy.
